deployment_note: All Hazelcast members and the driver run on THIS machine (one physical machine), communicating over the loopback interface 127.0.0.1. members = number of member JVM processes; threads_per_member = size of each member's 'matmul' executor; workers = members * threads_per_member. No inter-machine network is involved.
threads_note: Worker threads = executor threads that run BlockTasks. Each JVM also runs Hazelcast's own threads (partition operation threads, I/O threads, housekeeping), the JIT compilers and 1 SerialGC thread; their peak number is recorded per member (members.csv, peak_threads). No numerical library is used. Local references: p = threads of the LocalMatMul pool.
affinity_note: No CPU affinity / pinning: macOS does not let user programs bind threads or processes to cores, so the OS scheduler places them freely.
